Welcome to Ray of Beauty

Step in. Slow down. Glow.

Ray of Beauty Luxury Salon & Suites was created as a retreat from the everyday — a place where expert beauty professionals work from private, high-end suites, and every appointment feels like time set aside just for you.

From the moment you arrive, the details do the talking: soft light, calm spaces, and stylists and spa specialists who take their craft — and your comfort — seriously. We are actively welcoming new clients at both of our Jacksonville locations.
